notes.title: Damned 2 Update – The Blood Oracle
notes.notes:
Hello Everyone!


We are happy to announce that our first content update for Damned 2 is now live!  



This update brings one of the biggest new mechanics so far: the Blood Oracle. Survivors can now sacrifice the Heart at the Blood Altar to summon the Blood Whisper, a spectral guide that points to the next missing item. It’s a way to help when progress stalls, while still keeping the tension high because the monster can see the Heart and hears your voice chat while you’re carrying it.


New Feature: Blood Oracle
Blood Altar
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44209845/21475bd2f5357384df1aa76786e188354cf08c93.gif"]

Assists survivors in finding lost items by summoning the Blood Whisper.

Survivors must locate the Sacrificial Heart and place it on the altar.

Monsters cannot see or collide with the altar.


The Sacrificial Heart
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44209845/eb9423d8ba974ffca6141ba041a63f56edda27be.gif"]

Spawns in one of the already opened rooms a few minutes into a match.

The altar can reveal the Heart’s location or show the timer for the next spawn.

When active, the Heart emits a global directional heartbeat and moves around the map.

If carried, the monster can see the Heart and hear the carrier’s VOIP, and the AI becomes aware of the holder.

If not picked up within 3 minutes, the Heart respawns in another room.


The Blood Whisper
Slowly guides survivors to the next key or puzzle item.

Will not appear if survivors already hold an unused key or if there are unsolved puzzles, though the altar will still point to what’s missing.

Disappears once the guided item is collected; then a new Heart spawns.


Available Difficulty Modes
Beginner – First Heart at 4 minutes; new Heart spawns 1 minute after the last item is collected.

Normal – First Heart at 5 minutes; new Heart spawns 3 minutes later.

Limited – First Heart at 7 minutes; new Hearts spawn 5 minutes later. Limited to 2 total.

No Altar – Removes all altars from the map.


Banners
4 New banners for you to collect. 

The Heart: Use the Blood Oracle 4 times.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44209845/67d6b151c3ee484dca268c58cff4638830de5838.png"]

Blood Altar: Use the Blood Oracle 13 times in a match with the Normal Preset against a monster.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44209845/7d2a61eddf8402a7b024d9c6f326b7b25a3a57b9.png"]

Blood God: With 4 survivors, win using the Impossible Preset against Mary AI on Rose Crimson, and activate the Blood Altar 2 times during the match.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44209845/1959fb4243fff4aefb7b1021eae2eae60426d2c8.png"]

Host of the Damned: Complete 20 games in a public lobby.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44209845/c6372b65bb8caad3e7e0d41bc3fa4bb77f2e8ac5.png"]


Gameplay
Survivor lives now persist across the match. Players who reconnect return with the same lives they had before disconnecting.

Players who rejoin with zero lives cannot select a survivor that is still alive.

Players joining mid-game cannot take a dead survivor slot if a living one is available.


Maps
Added Blood Altars to all maps (one guaranteed in the main corridor/room; others may appear randomly).

Adjusted collision to prevent objects from getting stuck.

Added more puzzles across maps to reduce chances of puzzle shortages.


UI
Survivors can now see the remaining lives of other survivors.

Improved voice chat feedback.


Fixes
Escape door light now updates correctly for late-joining players.

Possible fix for Blight not attacking when too close.

Fixed client updates after leaving the profile menu.

Fixed inconsistent breakable object pieces.

Possible fix for breakable objects not auto-picking up.

Removed buzzing sounds from lights that shouldn’t have them.

Fixed a potential soft lock at Clandestine Hospital due to an incorrect spawn.

Fixed disappearing mouse when tutorial + chat were open.

Possible fix for puzzle letters not appearing on the ground.

Fixed valve rotation lock when survivors added valves too quickly.

Fixed some puzzles floating.

Fixed inventory items not clearing when a player left the game.

Fixed small issue with Blight’s energy bar UI.

Possible fix for profile window showing the wrong player.

Fixed a potential soft lock with the Oracle’s Gemstone puzzle at the Missing Warehouse.


What’s Next
We’re already working on the next steps for Damned 2:



Game tutorial for new Damned players.

Blight rework, making its gameplay more unique.

New puzzles to expand match variety.

New maps to explore and survive.

New Monster – a well-known character from Damned 1 will soon return to haunt your dreams.



We’re excited to see how you use this new mechanic, and as always, keep sending us your feedback!

notes.title: Damned 2 Update - 0.6.0000
notes.notes:
Hello everyone!

A new update for Damned 2 is now live. This patch introduces the UV Light mode, which allows survivors to reveal hidden messages and destroy traps. A new puzzle, Oracle’s Gemstone, has been added along with two new maps, Clandestine Hospital and The Great Vault. Various gameplay improvements, balance changes, and bug fixes have also been implemented.  

We are continuing to expand the UV Light mechanics and will be adding more interactions in future updates. Our focus will now shift to implementing the two remaining survivors and the new monster.  

Thank you to everyone who participated in testing and reported bugs. Your feedback has been invaluable in improving the game. If this patch proves to be stable, we plan to hold a Steam Playtest this weekend.

Just a reminder: this update is currently available only to select Discord members with access to our internal build.  

New Content

 New Flashlight Mode: UV Light – Reveals hidden messages and destroys monsters' traps.  
 New Puzzle: Oracle's Gemstone 
 New Maps: Clandestine Hospital & The Great Vault  

UV Light Changes 

 Fool’s Trap can now be destroyed with UV Light.  
 Cursed Dolls can now be destroyed with UV Light.  
Added Flashlight option in Control Settings to customize toggling with the new UV mode.  

Gameplay Improvements

 Puzzle papers and Laser Connection power switch now highlight when a survivor is near and looking at them.  
 Lurker energy loss (Simple form): Increased from 0 → 6.  
Max puzzles per match: Increased from 5 → 7.  
Mary (Berserking): Added blood-red eye screen effect.  
Battery & Sanity Pill spawns now adjust based on the number of survivors at the start of the game.  
Turn Table music attenuation distance reduced to avoid disturbing the Radio Frequency puzzle.  
 Lurker (Invisible speed):Increased from 330 → 440.  
 Mary (Berserker speed): Decreased from 800 → 700.  
 Mary AI ground friction: Reduced from 8 → 1.5.  
 Added a message when a puzzle unlocks a keybox.  
 Map generation updated to guarantee a final puzzle.  
 Monster AI adjusted to ignore flashlight toggle noise from survivors.  

Maps  

 Renamed some exit doors.  
 Missing Warehouse: Laser Connection moved to the middle of the clocks.  
 Rose Crimson: Added a secret door.

User Interface & Settings  

 Added Puzzle Selection Screen – Players can exclude puzzles from randomization.  
 Added Random Map Selection Window – Customize which maps are included in the Random Map option.  
 Added Photosensitive Correction in Gameplay Settings – This option will force flashing lights to stay On or Off.  
 Difficulty Selection UI Revamp: Now prompts when entering a lobby or clicking Difficulty to help new players customize settings.  
 Added Only Friends filter to Lobby Search.  
 Random Map Selection now appears at the top of the map list.  
 Added a Copy Seed button (Ctrl+V to paste).  
 Map Selection UI Overhaul: Displays more maps at once.  
 Renamed Game Options to "Difficulty" for clarity.  
 Added Gameplay tab in Settings (moved some video options here).  

Audio Adjustments

 Balanced Lurker's music and breathing sounds when hunting.  
Bug Fixes

 Fixed a Warehouse light that wasn’t interactable.  
 Fixed mouse cursor disappearing when pressing ESC while holding TAB.  
 Fixed TAB working while the ESC menu is open.  
 Fixed puzzles making noise at the start of the game.  
 Fixed ghost items appearing on top of puzzles.  
 Fixed small box lids getting stuck.  
 Fixed a 4th-floor room missing the Laser Connection End.  
 Fixed new puzzles not drawing at the correct distance.  
 Fixed Valve not highlighting when inserted into the Pressure Puzzle.  
 Fixed host starting with invalid items.  
 Fixed hearts graying out when changing localization.  
 Fixed multiple issues when playing with the same monster twice in a row.  
 Fixed some skill icons flashing red.  
 Fixed collision on hospital gurneys.  
 Fixed monsters getting too close to doors to open them properly.  
 Fixed Mary using skills immediately after transforming.  
 Adjusted voice chat attenuation distance for large maps.  
 Fixed collision issues blocking Possessed Objects' vision.  
 Fixed players getting downed inside the escape room.  


Known Issues
Changing the game language resets the difficulty.

Our next focus is on player feedback and suggestions to enhance the experience for new players, refine difficulty balancing, and improve tutorials. During this time, we’re also working on releasing the next two survivors and a new monster. However, we can’t promise a release date for the monster just yet.

notes.title: Damned 2 Update - 0.5.2000
notes.notes:
Hello Everyone!

We’ve been hard at work on exciting updates for Damned 2, and today's release brings fresh content, polished gameplay, and key improvements. Here's some of the Highlights:

Update Highlights


 3 New Maps: 4th Floor, Missing Warehouse, and Top Hill Restaurant.
 New Puzzle: Laser Connection – Find prisms to divert the laser to its target while navigating map obstacles.
 Survivor Upgrades: Lily and Lucas now have revamped 3D models and animations.

Monster Updates
 Mary: Reworked AI and Haunting abilities for more intense encounters.
 Lurker: Adjusted hunting mechanics and movement speed.
 New item mechanic: Survivors can now drop items from inventory.


And here's a sneak peek at what's coming next:


 A new puzzle, currently in development.
 Final 3D models are on the way for the remaining placeholder survivors (though Hudson will stay with us!).
 We've resumed work on Blight's long-awaited design.

If this update proves stable, we’ll host a public playtest on Steam next week, which will be the final test before entering Early Access.

Your feedback has been crucial, and we can’t wait to hear your thoughts on this update!
As always, please leave any feedback you may have in our discord or steam discussions.

All the best,
9heads games

notes.title: Damned 2 Update - 0.5.0068

As we gear up for the Steam Halloween event, we're excited to release a new update that introduces the Black Lake Facility map! This is the first iteration of the map, and we're eager to hear your feedback on its overall gameplay experience.

notes.title: Damned 2 Update - 0.5.0014
notes.notes:
Hello everyone!

Today's update brings a bit of everything—quality of life improvements, UI enhancements, new gameplay features, balance changes, bug fixes, and achievements! We also update the game engine to the latest version 5.4

When we introduced the idea of becoming a ghost after death, the goal was to give players something to do rather than just spectate, like in the original Damned. This patch adds a new mechanic for ghosts: you can now collect ghostly batteries, pills, and a Pump Inhaler to assist your living teammates. Just pick one up and aim at a survivor to use it.

Our localization system has also received a major overhaul. By popular demand, we’ve added Chinese, Russian and Spanish to the list of supported languages. However, please note that neither I nor Heliax speak these languages, so we relied on AI for the translations. We reviewed them by translating back to English and Portuguese to ensure clarity, but there might still be some errors. If you spot any mistakes, whether translation or formatting issues (like text overflow or strange characters), please let us know so we can fix them.

Additionally, we've added 38 achievements to the game, though they are currently locked. You can view them on Steam, and if you have any cool ideas for new achievements, feel free to share them with us on our Discord channel!

notes.title: Damned 2 Update - 0.4.2166
notes.notes:
Hi everyone!

Today we have the second patch following all the feedback gathered during our public playtest. This update focus on gameplay balance and some rework to Mary's gameplay along with optimizations and general bug fixing.

Changelog

Mary Rework:

 Cry Out skill has been remade into Mental Trace. This new skill temporarily teleports Mary near a survivor to localize them and gain some energy. The cooldown remain the same, with a 4-second duration.
 Mind Reach now pulls the nearest survivor, making it easier to use. It no longer goes on cooldown when possessing an object.
 Haunting will no longer close doors directly in front of Mary.
 Increased energy gain when a survivor is very close by 1200%.
 Reduced transformation time from 2 seconds to 1 second.
 Increased the distance of Blink while Haunting from 250 to 350 units.
 Decreased the speed of Blink while Haunting by 30%.
 Increased ground friction while walking by 14%.
 Increased the number of possessable objects available when leaving Berserk mode by 75%.
 Mary’s AI difficulty has been slightly increased.
 Mary’s AI will only enter Berserk mode when a survivor is seen.
 Destroying Dolls now grants 66% more energy.
 Dolls now affect the survivor’s vision and speed for a few seconds when destroyed.
 Mary’s music will only play for survivors when their actions impact her energy gain.
 Increased passive energy regeneration while Haunting by 20%.

Lurker:

 Removed all feedback of energy changes for survivors.
 Increased the frequency at which the AI uses Shadow Dance at Normal and Hard difficulties.
 Increased the stun duration of Fool's Trap from 0.5 seconds to 1 second.
 Updated Prey Tracker and Ethereal Sense effects:
 Ethereal Sense (Passive skill) now reduces a small amount of sanity when a survivor passes by while invisible.
 Lurker loses half of his energy after hitting a survivor when only 1 survivor remains.

Balance Changes:

 Improved monster vision when visible.
 Reduced survivor downed time by 50% when only one survivor is alive.
 Decreased the frequency of the Heart sanity effect by 50% and added an effect when sanity drops below 5%.

Interface:

 Added the actual voice volume bar back.

notes.title: Damned 2 Update - 0.2.1853
notes.notes:
Hi everyone!

Today we have a couple of VERY exciting news to share and a new update for Damned 2. 

Let's start with the news first.

After much anticipation, we are delighted to welcome back Matt Collins as the music composer for Damned 2!

For those who have been with us since the beginning, you'll remember Matt's outstanding work as the composer for the original Damned game. His talent and creativity brought the world of Damned to life, captivating players and enhancing the gaming experience in ways that words can hardly describe.

Now for the second part of the news.

We are happy to announce an epic collaboration between 9heads Games and Artdaggers Outsourcing Studio! 

Artdaggers will be in charge of bringing back to life some iconic characters of the original game as well as creating new survivors and monsters for Damned 2! With their expertise in character design and our dedication to delivering seamless gameplay, we are confident that this partnership will take Damned 2 to a whole new level.

A few weeks ago we hosted a pool in our Discord channel to decide the concept art that fits best our next upcoming monster, Mary. Yes! Mary is coming back to haunt your dreams!

Together, with these new partners, we are embarking on an incredible journey to bring you an even more immersive gaming experience.

If you want to know more and get a chance to chat with Matt yourself, get into our Discord channel.

Patch Notes:

The main feature is a brand new map: Alba's Motel.
Who's Alba? Why there is a scientist painting in her Room? Well... get ready to to know more about the Damned universe soon!

This update also includes a localization system, this means we can now translate the game to as many languages as we want to. So if you wish to help us to bring Damned to your language, get into our Discord to learn how you can help!

There are also new traps, new sound effects, new game options, lots of balance and bug fixes.

notes.title: Damned 2 Update - 0.1.1599
notes.notes:
Hi Everyone!
Today I bring you a new patch note. This patch focuses on fixing bugs, improving new door/drawer mechanics, VOIP, usability, networking and game balance. This patch took longer than usual due to the complexity of the door and drawer mechanics that now involve physics.

Highlights:

 Now the monster can listen to survivors for a brief period of time when they fall into traps. You can hear your friend getting scared, or cursing you =]
 
 We have added new containers and safes for you to search for items, the safes can contain all kinds of items, including keys, but you will have to find the password hidden on the map.
 
 Various balance adjustments to make the monster have more interaction with survivors, more hunts and more scares.
 
 We have added several usability options, such as color blind options and brightness adjustment.


A few weeks ago I announced to you that we are working on improvements to the game's audio and sound effects, unfortunately we didn't have time to include these audios before the end of the year, so it will be for the next patch, but we have already approved the material sent by our audio partners and we're excited to see your reaction.

This will be the last patch for this year, but I would like to announce that we are closing partnerships that will take Damned 2 to a new level in 2024 if everything goes well. I can't wait to tell you!

We will also be removing the DEMO version of Damned 2, so new players will need to sign up for our Steam Playtest starting early next year.
So if you have friends who want to join the game before the Playtest, ask them to join our discord and send me a PM.

And now with you, the patch notes:

Gameplay
